## About
The M Shop works on BMW and MINI Cooper. That's the focus: maintenance, service, and repair, out of our shop at 3211 Verdugo Rd.
We work by appointment. One customer said the wait to get on the schedule was worth it, and that once the car was in, it was turned around quick.
Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 113 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that Joe explained the issues thoroughly and didn't try to upsell.

## Services
- Maintenance, service, and repair: Regular maintenance, service, and repair work, start to finish.
- Inspections: One customer had us inspect a used car he'd just bought. Another got a full inspection with a list of next steps.
- Brakes, rotors and suspension: One reviewer's car got brakes, rotors and a new suspension setup during the same visit.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: BMW and MINI Cooper.
